rezumat: Milestones A (safe incremental collection), B (INS), C (12 entries), D (meanings and shared groups) and E (preview, coverage, report) are complete.

Structured field evidence now covers {with_fields} of {finder} projects and resources (baseline 14). The retained sources are {source_urls} URLs ({parsed} parsed, {failed} failed) with {field_records:,} field records.
Each field record is a path in a source. The proposals are {groups} shared groups (baseline 7), 16 provider review items and the dictionary evidence that `inventory.py --check` verifies.
The public build is unchanged: the default payload equals the v0.13.0 payload apart from its generation time; classifications and accepted providers are identical.
Collection used {direct_requests} direct requests in total ({browser_navigations} browser navigations); the 150-request limit of lot C was not reached.

afacut.rezultat: Describes public money for roads, water and sewer, and gas networks: the national reporting steps (date, step and cumulative amount, in billions of lei) and a county ranking (amount per 100 lei allocated, allocated and requested amounts in millions of lei, localities with requests as "x din y"). Every unit comes from a table header. The search page loads no data and says that it runs in demonstration mode, so no locality-level dataset was found. The locality search is an HTML control candidate, not an accepted input.

dignitas.rezultat: Collaborative fact-checking platform. Ten repository files at commit c865254 (2026-03-13): nine SQL patches that create or alter tables such as entity, statement, relation, vote and tag, and the Statement class, whose constants define the statement types (claim, flop, promise) and the verdict scale. The repository link is the one that the profiler found on the project site.
dignitas.limite_en: 74 of 84 patches are unread, so the table list is partial. Constants give codes, not columns.
dignitas.urmator_en: Read the remaining patches or a current schema dump; confirm the live verdict scale.

limite: Documentele de proiectare dau forme de exemplu, nu un contract.

monitorul-ai.urmatorul_pas: Citiți schema canonică JSON, dacă este publică, și eșantioane din arhivă prin site.
monitorul-ai.rezultat: Public archive of Romanian parliamentary stenograms (Monitorul Oficial, Part II). Two design documents show the record shapes: a document envelope, session metadata, agenda items, speeches, votes with counts for, against and abstaining, speaker identity (name, title, role, party group, person id) and source spans. Four JSON Schemas describe the discourse-analysis outputs. The MCP guide lists the tools that the archive exposes.

monitorul-ai.urmator_en: Find a canonical JSON schema if one is public; sample the archive through the site.

ins: Listing `https://ins.gov2.ro/api/datasets?limit=1`: HTTP 200, 557 bytes, `total` 3,368 datasets, 16 card members. The llms.txt file says "about 3,600". Only `limit=1` was run; `offset` is documented but unverified.

Five metadata records were read: ACC102B (available again, same body hash as on 2026-10-24), POP107D, LOC101B, TRN139A and GOS104A. The codes come from the pages of the projects that name them, and every use has an exact locator in the registry: POP107D (`constru-pentru-cine`, `orasul-care-se-intinde`, `demoanaf`), LOC101B (`constru-pentru-cine`, `orasul-care-se-intinde`, `biografia-localitatii`), TRN139A and GOS104A (`unde-se-termina-asfaltul`; GOS104A also `biografia-localitatii`).

Each record separates one indicator (the definition text), four to six dimensions and the dimension values, which appear only as samples of at most five codes with their labels. A dimension value is never a variable. Each dataset has one measure field `OBS_VALUE` whose declared unit comes from the unit dimension: persons (POP107D), number (LOC101B), kilometres (TRN139A, GOS104A). ACC102B declares two units (persons and per mille), so no single unit is chosen.

Misleading example: llms.txt presents `GET /api/datasets/ACC102B?lang=en` as "GDP". The record is workplace accidents (`CATEGORY`, `REF_AREA`, `TIME_PERIOD`, `UNIT_MEASURE`). Its source note names the Labour Inspectorate (Ministry of Labour); INS distribution alone does not prove authorship, so the proposal D160 is limited to that dataset and does not change the INS relation.
The `POP101A` example route of llms.txt was not re-measured. The 404 in the brief stays an unverified claim here.

Coverage differs between the mirror and the projects. LOC101B time options end in 2023 against 1990–2025 in `constru-pentru-cine`; POP107D ends in 2025 against 2026; TRN139A ends in 2024 against 2025. The projects read TEMPO directly; these records are metadata from the ins.gov2.ro mirror and are labelled so.

Locality dimension labels begin with a number (for example `38731 RIPICENI`). The POP107D note declares SIRUTA 38731 for Ripiceni and 98916 for Scânteia, and the options carry exactly those numbers, while a second Scânteia has 94429. This supports but does not prove that the leading token is SIRUTA for all localities; it stays an ambiguity note in `siruta`.

rezultate: `python3 scripts/build.py`: succeeds. The default public payload equals the v0.13.0 payload apart from `generated`; the classifications and the accepted providers of all 140 entries are equal; `site/index.html` differs only by the asset stamps that the build writes.

Unit tests: 411 run, 6 skipped, 0 failures (baseline 308 / 6). New files: `test_inventory_state` 39, `test_inventory_text` 19, `test_inventory_concepts` 19, `test_inventory_ins` 12, `test_inventory_report` 7; `test_inventory` 15, `test_inventory_site` 11 and `test_collect_docs` 15 grew.

`python3 scripts/inventory.py --check`: 0 evidence errors; 86 source bodies hash-verified; 62 dictionary evidence items verified, 0 stale; 0 sources with a failed refresh. On a copy without any body: 0 errors, 0 bodies verified, 136 reported unavailable (never counted as verified); `--strict-snapshots` then exits 1.

Replay: `inventory.py --offline` on a copy of the tracked folder reproduces `proiecte.json`, `seturi-date.json`, `descoperiri.json`, `rezumat.csv`, `campuri.csv` and `intrari-utilizator.csv` byte for byte.

`python3 scripts/build.py --site-dir /tmp/civtech-inventory-expanded --with-inventory`: succeeds (127 entries and 30 groups in the finder index). The flag without `--site-dir` exits 2 and leaves `site/data.json` unchanged (test). Reusing an isolated folder without the flag removes the draft pages (test).

Browser, against the served preview on port 8770: `check_preview.py` 111/111, `check_inventory_preview.py` 31/31, `check_data_finder.py` 31/31 (baseline 25/25 for each inventory script). The expected counts come from the generated index and from filter rules written in the script, not from the page code; layouts at 390 px and 320 px have no horizontal overflow.

Boundaries: nothing was pushed or deployed, no Google Sheet was touched, no paid service ran, no project owner was contacted. `relatii.csv`, the sealed `source/`, `reference/` and `runs/` folders and the frozen v1 files have no change from the baseline; `revizuire.csv` only gained D147–D162 and D132–D146 are unchanged.
